Our Community Safety Commitment

A Safer Place to Ask. A Safer Way to Help.

At DebtFreeLately, we believe everyone deserves to be treated with dignity, kindness, and respect, regardless of their financial situation.

Our community is built to connect people who need financial support with those willing to make a difference.

Where we are today

The app currently provides email verification, admin card review, rule-based alerts for potentially duplicate profiles or unusual submission activity, and admin controls to notify or block members. These signals require human review. Government ID checks, document analysis, creditor confirmation, payments and a member reporting tool are not yet available.

Protecting Our Community

  1. 1

    Identity & Account Verification

    We use email verification and account review procedures to help reduce misuse of our platform. Additional identity verification is planned to help address impersonation and fraudulent accounts; email verification alone does not verify a person's identity.

  2. 2

    Fraud Prevention

    Admins review submitted debt stories and can inspect alerts for shared profile details, matching stories and frequent submissions. We plan to extend these checks to supporting documents and creditor information. A warning is a reason to investigate, not a finding of fraud.

  3. 3

    Respectful Interactions

    We do not tolerate harassment, discrimination, threats, intimidation, exploitation, or attempts to take advantage of vulnerable members.

  4. 4

    Safe Financial Support

    Our intended payment model would direct financial contributions toward verified creditors through authorised payment channels, rather than into the personal accounts of Broke members. Payment processing is not yet available in the app.

  5. 5

    Reporting & Accountability

    Members will be able to report suspicious accounts, inappropriate behaviour, and potential violations of our community rules when the reporting tool is introduced. Reports are intended to be reviewed before appropriate action is taken.

    Admins can currently send in-app notices, block or unblock accounts, and review the recorded reasons for those actions.

Our Promise

We are committed to creating a community where asking for help is never a source of shame, and offering support does not mean compromising personal safety.

“Every person deserves respect. Every act of kindness deserves protection.”

DebtFreeLately — No One Gets Debt Free Alone.
